title: Move CSV rerun workflow to Queue tab
summary: Moves the CSV rerun operator workflow from Launch into a dedicated Queue CSV Rerun tab while preserving existing /api/rerun/* backend route ownership and evidence flows.
reason: CSV rerun is an audit-remediation queue builder with special source, replacement, review, and publish behavior, so it should live beside Queue review/scoping workflows without being converted into normal /api/pipeline/start rows.
behavior_before: Launch exposed CSV Rerun as a Launch tab and initialized the rerun controls directly from Launch page wiring.
behavior_after: Queue exposes a CSV Rerun tab with import, preview, scope, replacement, start/continue, and results controls; Queue owns literal /api/rerun/* route dispatch while Launch keeps transitional render/helper functions only.
manual_validation: node --check queueView.rerun.js queueView.js launchView.js app.js launch/commandButtons.js reports/*.js and check-webview-command-boundary.mjs - passed
python -m unittest targeted Queue/Launch CSV rerun static tests - passed
python -m unittest test_api_command_contracts test_path_picker_command test_webview_path_picker_badges - passed
python -m unittest test_rerun_csv_preview test_facade_process_rerun_policy test_process_rerun_results - passed
rollback_plan: Restore the Launch CSV Rerun tab/panel and old Launch event bindings, remove queueView.rerun.js plus the Queue tab wrapper, and revert inventory/test ownership entries from Queue back to Launch.
